environment.description: Same Spring Boot 3.1 application on ECS Fargate behind ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL (regional scope) with the following configuration: (1) AWS managed rule group 'AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet' in COUNT mode for logging, (2) a custom rule with priority 1 that inspects the request Body with a SizeConstraint of 10MB and BLOCK action for oversized payloads, (3) a custom regex pattern set rule (priority 2) applied to Body bytes that matches patterns containing sequences of '../' or '..\\' encoded in any combination of URL-encoding, double-encoding, or raw bytes — using a RegexPatternSet with patterns '(?:\\.\\.[\\/\\\\]){2,}' and '(?:%2e%2e[%2f%5c]){2,}' with TextTransformation of URL_DECODE followed by LOWERCASE, action BLOCK. The container also runs with a read-only root filesystem (readonlyRootFilesystem: true in ECS task definition) with only /var/data/uploads mounted as a writable tmpfs volume.
